suggestions.track: Priority 1 · Read Like a Shop, Not an Audit
suggestions.title: Lead above the fold with the 5-product shoppable shortlist and format roles, keeping audit registers in footer & Desk nav
suggestions.problem: Audit-first landing pages overwhelm buyers with internal verification jargon before showing what the products actually do.
suggestions.proposal: Open the front page with clear buyer format cards (Dual-Basket 6 Qt, French-Door 26 Qt Oven, Single-Basket 8 Qt, Instant-Read Probe, 3-Probe Wireless), interactive fit filters, and direct paid-link CTAs, while routing registers and flags through one Desk nav item and the footer.

suggestions.track: Priority 1 · Read Like a Shop, Not an Audit
suggestions.title: Add an interactive Countertop Fit Finder matching batch size, counter clearance, and cooking task
suggestions.problem: Buyers comparing 2×3 qt drawers, an 8 qt single basket, and a 26 qt French-door oven struggle to translate quart numbers into real kitchen fit.
suggestions.proposal: Provide instant client-side workflow filters (Two foods at once, Single-layer batches, Sheet-pan & holiday trays, Spot-check vs leave-in roast) that narrow the shortlist and log aggregate comparison_filter_use events.

suggestions.track: Priority 1 · Read Like a Shop, Not an Audit
suggestions.title: Pair air fryers with meat thermometers as a natural kitchen workflow rather than hiding category split
suggestions.problem: Three air fryers and two meat thermometers look mismatched if presented without culinary context.
suggestions.proposal: Cross-link P-04 (instant-read) with drawer air fryers (P-01, P-03) for quick drawer checks and P-05 (wireless leave-in probes) with the French-door oven (P-02) for closed-door roasting.

suggestions.title: Publish question-shaped and seasonal kitchen guides wired into sitemap.xml and feed.xml
suggestions.problem: Thin product blurbs rarely rank for real buyer questions such as dual-basket vs single-basket math or holiday oven overflow.
suggestions.proposal: Ship 8 concrete, non-fluff buyer guides (4 core working hypotheses + 4 seasonal/weeknight problem solvers), automatically listed in sitemap.xml and RSS feed.xml, then select future topics from Search Console Queries.

suggestions.title: Separate Product-Intent Confirmation fields strictly from Observed Redirect fields in JSON and HTML
suggestions.problem: Merging observed /dp/ redirects into intended_asin hides whether a short link points to the wrong product or variant.
suggestions.proposal: Enforce two distinct schema objects (intent_confirmation vs observed_redirect) validated on every build by platform/compliance_gate.py and platform/verify_edition.py.

suggestions.title: Replace ambiguous link.amazon URLs with Associates-validated Special Links after signed-in click test
suggestions.problem: No tag=shopnow047c-20 parameter appeared on redirect arrival, and P-04/P-05 showed historical instability, while FLG-003 remains unresolved.
suggestions.proposal: Require operator sign-in to Associates Central to generate fresh Special Links for each confirmed 10-character ASIN and verify one non-purchasing click in Associates Reports before paid scaling.

suggestions.title: Ship privacy-preserving 5-event click counter and self-hosted collector with an empty Campaign Ledger
suggestions.problem: Third-party trackers add cookie banners and privacy risk, while fabricated conversion scores distort capital allocation.
suggestions.proposal: Track only aggregate daily counts of 5 defined events (page_view, product_card_click, guide_to_product_click, comparison_filter_use, suggestion_decision) honoring DNT/GPC, and import reported_orders solely from signed-in Associates CSV exports via platform/ledger.py.

suggestions.title: Block CI deploys on missing §5 disclosure, unsponsored retail links, dollar prices, or broken anchors
suggestions.problem: Manual edits routinely drop above-the-fold disclosures, omit rel='sponsored', or introduce stale prices.
suggestions.proposal: Run platform/verify_edition.py in .github/workflows/edition-verify.yml on every push and pull request to fail loudly on any policy or link defect.

suggestions.track: Parallel Polish Pass (SG-27..SG-30) · Read Like a Publication
suggestions.title: SG-27: Replace audit-speak navigation labels with reader-first editorial labels
suggestions.problem: Navigation bars stuffed with 'Audit', 'Telemetry', and 'Schema' read like internal engineering tools rather than a kitchen magazine.
suggestions.proposal: Use five plain-English masthead links (Shop Shortlist, Categories, Buying Guides, Compare, Decision Desk) and group governance/verification links cleanly in the footer.

suggestions.track: Parallel Polish Pass (SG-27..SG-30) · Read Like a Publication
suggestions.title: SG-28: Ship valid RSS 2.0 feed (feed.xml) auto-discovered from every page <head>
suggestions.problem: Readers and syndication tools need a zero-tracking way to follow new seasonal and buyer guides.
suggestions.proposal: Generate feed.xml alongside sitemap.xml on every build and expose <link rel='alternate' type='application/rss+xml'> in every HTML head.

suggestions.track: Parallel Polish Pass (SG-27..SG-30) · Read Like a Publication
suggestions.title: SG-29: Connect Google Search Console and feed query exports into platform/research_engine.py
suggestions.problem: Choosing the next 10 articles by instinct wastes effort when real search impressions show exact buyer phrasing.
suggestions.proposal: Verify domain/URL-prefix ownership in Search Console, submit sitemap.xml, and run platform/research_engine.py on exported Queries CSVs to prioritize high-impression, low-CTR buyer questions.

suggestions.track: Parallel Polish Pass (SG-27..SG-30) · Read Like a Publication
suggestions.title: SG-30: Gate email newsletter capture behind opted-in CAN-SPAM & Associates §4 compliance
suggestions.problem: Adding an email box without an unsubscribe system, physical mailing address, and §4 Special-Link rules creates legal exposure.
suggestions.proposal: Keep RSS active immediately and hold email capture until an opted-in provider is configured that links subscribers to on-site articles rather than raw Special Links.

suggestions.title: REJECTED: Automated scraping of Amazon prices, star ratings, or customer review excerpts
suggestions.problem: Many generic AI affiliate prompts ask agents to scrape live Amazon prices, star ratings, and review counts.
suggestions.proposal: Reject permanently unless connected through approved Creators API / PA API credentials under Participation Requirements §2(b) and §6(t).

suggestions.title: REJECTED: Public price-drop trackers or automated price-alert widgets
suggestions.problem: Price-history charts and drop alerts are common affiliate growth hacks that violate Amazon Associates rules.
suggestions.proposal: Reject under Participation Requirements §6(y): 'Unless otherwise agreed by Amazon, your Site must not have price tracking and/or price alerting functionality.'

prompt_modules.label: Concrete Kitchen Prose (Ban AI Clichés & Fake Hands-On Claims)
prompt_modules.why_it_converts: Real buyers bounce immediately from generic 'In today's fast-paced kitchen...' fluff. Specific geometry trade-offs (2×3 qt drawers vs one 8 qt floor vs 26 qt rack clearance) earn reader trust.
prompt_modules.prompt_instruction: Write in crisp, observant kitchen-magazine prose. Ban filler openings ('In today's world', 'Whether you're a busy parent', 'Game-changer', 'Ultimate guide', 'Delve into'). Never claim hands-on lab testing, taste tests, or 'Best Overall' awards unless physical test logs exist; frame product specs strictly from verified seller titles and manufacturer manuals, and explain what each physical dimension or feature changes during real weeknight cooking.

prompt_modules.label: Warm Culinary Editorial Palette + Above-the-Fold Shoppable Shortlist
prompt_modules.why_it_converts: Visitors landing from search want to compare viable options in 10 seconds before reading 1,500 words.
prompt_modules.prompt_instruction: Design a warm, tactile editorial storefront (linen ground #FAF7F2, crisp white product cards, cast-iron ink #18181B, terracotta primary CTAs #B84A27, tabular numerals). Place the Associates disclosure strip directly beneath the masthead, then open immediately with the categorized product shortlist cards, 'Best Fit If / Skip If' buyer callouts, and an interactive workflow filter.

prompt_modules.label: High-Intent Problem & Seasonal Article Clusters (Zero Volume Hallucination)
prompt_modules.why_it_converts: Long-tail problem queries ('two 3-quart baskets vs one 8-quart', 'holiday side dishes in countertop oven', 'reheating pizza drawer vs rack', 'instant-read vs wireless leave-in probe') attract buyers right before purchase.
prompt_modules.prompt_instruction: Build topic clusters around concrete kitchen bottlenecks and seasonal cooking moments: (1) Dual-zone synchronization vs single-drawer width, (2) Holiday oven overflow & side-dish batching, (3) Crispy leftover reheating physics (perforated basket vs wire rack), (4) Counter depth, cabinet steam clearance & dishwasher cleanup, and (5) Pairing instant-read vs wireless leave-in thermometers with convection cookers. Treat topics as hypotheses until validated in Google Search Console.

prompt_modules.label: Trade-Off Matrix + 'Buy If / Skip If' Cards + Paired Workflow Upsell
prompt_modules.why_it_converts: Honest 'Skip If' criteria eliminate buyer hesitation and reduce post-click abandonment.
prompt_modules.prompt_instruction: Give every product card and comparison row an explicit 'Fits Best When' and 'Skip When' rule, a side-by-side verified attribute table with blank '—' cells for unconfirmed specs, and a natural cross-category pairing (e.g., pairing a drawer air fryer with an instant-read thermometer to prevent overcooked poultry).

prompt_modules.label: Strict Associates §5, Policies §2(b)/§6(t)/§6(y), FTC 16 CFR 255 & rel='sponsored'
prompt_modules.why_it_converts: Protects the Associates account from termination while keeping paid links transparent.
prompt_modules.prompt_instruction: Include verbatim 'As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.' above <main> and in <footer> on every page. Mark every Amazon product link rel='sponsored nofollow noopener' with visible 'Paid link' microcopy. Never hardcode or scrape prices, star ratings, review counts, stock status, or price-tracking alerts without approved Creators API / PA API access.

prompt_modules.label: Subpath-Safe Relative URLs, Clean Sitemap, RSS Feed & Fast Zero-JS-Required HTML
prompt_modules.why_it_converts: Fast, zero-layout-shift static HTML with valid canonicals and zero broken links indexes cleanly on GitHub Pages.
prompt_modules.prompt_instruction: Render semantic static HTML5 that works completely without JavaScript, enhanced progressively for interactive filters. Compute all internal links and asset paths as relative URLs so project subpaths (/Affil1/) never 404. Auto-generate sitemap.xml and RSS 2.0 feed.xml from the canonical page list.

prompt_modules.label: 5-Event Aggregate Click Counter + Provenance-Locked Associates Ledger
prompt_modules.why_it_converts: Measures which guides actually drive outbound product clicks without invasive tracking scripts.
prompt_modules.prompt_instruction: Instrument only five privacy-preserving events (page_view, product_card_click, guide_to_product_click, comparison_filter_use, suggestion_decision) honoring DNT and Global Privacy Control with zero cookies. Keep the Campaign Ledger empty until populated from signed-in Amazon Associates CSV reports with SHA-256 provenance.

prompt_modules.label: Official PDF Manual Spec Backfill (Wattage, Dimensions, Tray Size)
prompt_modules.why_it_converts: Exact cabinet height and drawer interior width answer the #1 pre-purchase objection for small kitchens.
prompt_modules.prompt_instruction: Only after the operator confirms each product's intended 10-character ASIN, fetch the official brand PDF user manual (CHEFMAN, Emeril Lagasse, ThermoMaven, CHEF iQ), verify exterior H×W×D dimensions and wattage line by line, and cite the manual URL per row.
